scenario_description:
Objective: Make next week’s firewood stacking easier to read by adding no-cost row tags during setup.
Emerging Need: A vague leftover-supply notice becomes useful only when the available kit types, hold route, pickup help, and cutoff align.
Decision Context: Stored woodshed guidance identifies which tag set fits the cabin’s planned stack and limits the response to a reversible hold request.
Consequence: Ignoring the chance leaves normal firewood stacking unchanged, while after the hold list closes the optional organization upgrade cannot be picked up today.

parameter.title: East ridge firewood stacking reset
parameter.description: Stack the new delivery under woodshed cover and leave the older west rack undisturbed.

parameter.subject: Possible leftover firewood-label supplies today
parameter.body: The Extension table may have a few no-cost firewood labeling extras after this morning’s workshop. Please wait for the posted stock list before asking for a hold; staff cannot guess which packet suits a home stack.

parameter.content: I’ll pass the county office around 3:30 on my hardware run. If a small packet is already held in your name by 2, I can pick it up, but I can’t choose among versions from the shelf.

parameter.name: Washington County Extension Energy Desk
parameter.notes: Manages same-day no-cost firewood labeling packet holds for pickup from the county office side-door shelf.

parameter.subject: Firewood rotation packet stock list and 2 PM hold cutoff
parameter.body: Today’s extras are limited to one small-row blue tag set, two orange boiler-yard tag sets, and several metal moisture-meter reference cards. Holds are by email only until 2:00 PM; include the requested packet, the holder’s name, and who will pick it up. Unclaimed packets return to outreach inventory after the afternoon pickup shelf is cleared.

parameter.subject: Firewood rotation packet hold list closed
parameter.body: The 2:00 PM same-day hold list is now closed so staff can label the pickup shelf before the afternoon office run. Remaining packet questions will be handled at the next workshop date.
